handoff.objective: The CEO result page (EngineeringResult) reports how many developer attempts a job has used (developer_attempts) but never how many remain against the work order's own authorized ceiling, so reading the page requires separately looking up max_developer_attempts and subtracting by hand every time. Add a field to EngineeringResult reporting the developer attempts remaining, populated from the job's own existing corrections_remaining property (do not reimplement the arithmetic), and show it on the CEO page's text rendering next to the existing developer attempts line.
handoff.result: Added `developer_attempts_remaining: int` to `EngineeringResult`, populated in `build()` directly from `job.corrections_remaining` (no arithmetic reimplemented), and shown on the CEO page alongside the existing developer attempts line as `developer attempts: N  remaining: M`. The field round-trips through `to_dict` (via `to_jsonable`) and `from_mapping` identically to every other integer field.
risks: Stored results serialized before this change will deserialize with developer_attempts_remaining=0 (the from_mapping default), which is correct for any job that has exhausted its attempts but misleading for a mid-loop snapshot that was stored without the field; a reviewer should confirm whether historical result records matter.
